final: WITH media_groups AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS average_price, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS overall_average FROM media_groups) SELECT g.media_type_name, g.average_price, g.average_bytes_per_millisecond, g.average_bytes_per_millisecond / NULLIF(o.overall_average, 0) FROM media_groups AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_average IS NOT NULL
